package.description: 开源桌面 AI 智能体工作台，覆盖工具、文件、知识与工作流。

en-US.description: An open-source desktop AI agent workspace for tools, files, knowledge, and real deliverables.
en-US.longDescription: Pinvou Agent is an open-source desktop AI agent workspace for work, design, and coding. It brings everyday tasks, visual design, and software development into one desktop workspace designed to end with a result rather than another chat response: use tools, work with files, build personal knowledge, bring a dedicated coding agent into a real project over ACP, or turn a prompt into a visual artifact you can keep editing.

zh-CN.description: 开源桌面 AI 智能体工作台，覆盖工具、文件、知识与工作流。
zh-CN.longDescription: Pinvou Agent 是一个开源的桌面 AI 智能体工作区，面向工作、设计与编程。它把日常事务、可视化设计和软件开发整合进同一个桌面工作区，让任务以真实结果收尾：可以使用工具、处理文件、积累个人知识，通过 ACP 在真实项目中引入专用编码智能体，或将提示词变成可持续编辑的可视化作品。
zh-CN.name: pinvou3
